**0401936**  
**Criticizing Hadith According to Founders** (3 credit Hours)  
This course studies the bases on which the Founders of Islamic Jurisprudence build their opinions to criticize Hadith, and the attitude of Hadith Scholars from this matter. It aims also to discuss certain issues which are joined between Hadith and Jurisprudence.
